name: Detail Daemon family (lies about sigma)
plain: Not noise injection in code: the model is told a lower sigma than the actual one, in a chosen sigma window, so it removes less noise than it should. Listed here because it is often grouped with noise tools.
math:
σ' = σ·max(1e-6, 1 − mult(σ)·SCALE); x0 = model(x,σ').
'look only' mode: x0_real = x − (σ/σ')·(x − x0).
'keep structure': also evaluates true σ and keeps only the fine part of the change.

providers.author: lonecatone23
providers.note: Own implementation with look only and keep structure modes; adds APPLY_MODEL wrapper. The pack ComfyUI-Detail-Daemon has no source in the library; only a patch file.

label: from code
surprise: The model call is lied to; no noise tensor is added at any point.
